create_visualizer: create a GeoscorerDatasetVisualizer instance with a dataset to visualize voxel data via Visdom
set_model: set a model and optional opts on the GeoscorerDatasetVisualizer for model-assisted visualization
visualize_dataset: visualize the next dataset example showing context, segmentation, and combined voxel plots
visualize_with_model: visualize a dataset example and overlay model-predicted voxel coordinates using scores
review_visualization_utils: review the GeoscorerDatasetVisualizer class and its methods for voxel model visualization
